intro: Picture this: you step into the lobby to art-deco design, pretty floral arrangements and a signature scent many guests remember from the first step — Hotel MOCO is a boutique hotel that many reviews call a calm corner amid the bustle of Udon · It's an easy walk to UD Town and just a few hundred metres from the train station · 68 rooms with plush beds, a cafe and service guests consistently praise · from approx. ฿1,200/night · scored 9.6 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Hotel MOCO is a 68-room boutique hotel sitting on Thong Yai Road in Mak Khaeng, central Udon Thani · What sets it apart from other hotels in town is its thoroughly considered art-deco design, from a lobby with pretty floral arrangements to the signature scent many reviews mention recognising from the first step · The location is an advantage too: it's an easy walk to UD Town, only around 280 metres from Udon Thani train station, and about an 11-minute walk to Central Plaza.

Rooms range from a roughly 32 sqm Deluxe up to the 72 sqm Suite · What guests mention most is that the beds are wonderfully plush and the rooms genuinely clean, with many calling it the best sleep of their trip · Higher room categories add premium touches that make them feel upscale, such as a JBL Bluetooth speaker and a Nespresso coffee machine · Bathroom toiletries are good quality, with a walk-in shower and a flat-screen TV · Some rooms look out onto a small garden, which adds a relaxed feel even in the middle of the city.
"The room was clean with a lovely faint scent throughout the hotel, the bed was so soft I had the best sleep of my trip, and the staff genuinely looked after us."

Service is another thing reviews praise consistently · Staff are friendly, attentive and helpful, check-in is hassle-free, and couples in particular rate their stays especially highly · The hotel has a restaurant serving Thai and international dishes, plus a bar, a cafe and massage spa services · Breakfast is an Asian-style buffet that many call tasty and nicely presented, though a few reviews note the selection isn't very wide · There's free parking and an airport shuttle, handy since Udon Thani Airport is around 6-7 km away.

To be straight about it, the most common complaint is noise · Some reviews describe fairly thin walls, with street noise and a nearby bar with live music audible until late — as late as 1 a.m. on some nights · If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room set deeper inside away from the road and pack earplugs just in case · The hotel acknowledges this and has tried to improve it, but it's still worth keeping in mind before you book.

Another thing to know is that the hotel has no swimming pool and no gym · One review puts it bluntly: if it had a pool, it would already be the number-one spot in Udon · On top of that, some guests feel it's a touch pricey for the facilities on offer, and there are cheaper options in town · A few restaurant and concierge staff speak limited English, which some international travellers find a minor hurdle.

The review numbers capture the picture well · The overall score is 9.6 from around 296 reviews on Trip.com, while TripAdvisor gives it 4.8 of 5 and ranks it around #9 of 73 hotels in Udon Thani, with a Travelers' Choice award · These numbers show most guests are genuinely impressed, especially with cleanliness, design, the beds and service, while the grumbles tend to centre on noise and the lack of a pool.

Bottom line from real guest reviews: Hotel MOCO suits travellers who want a beautifully designed, clean room with a plush bed and great service, in a location walkable to UD Town and near the train station · If you're arriving by train or touring the city and value a comfortable room over a pool, it offers a worthwhile stay · But if you need a pool and gym, or you're a light sleeper, choose an interior room carefully or consider an option with fuller facilities.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Hotel MOCO Udon Thani

faq.q: Where is Hotel MOCO and what's nearby?
faq.a: Hotel MOCO sits on Thong Yai Road in Mak Khaeng, central Udon Thani · It's an easy walk to UD Town, around 280 metres from Udon Thani train station and about an 11-minute walk to Central Plaza · Udon Thani Airport is roughly 6-7 km away, about a 12-minute drive.

faq.q: How much does Hotel MOCO cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at approx. ฿1,200/night for a Deluxe Room of around 32 sqm · Other options include the Executive Room (King, with a JBL speaker and Nespresso machine), Grand Deluxe and a 72 sqm Suite · High-season rates rise, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Hotel MOCO have a swimming pool?
faq.a: No — there's no pool and no gym · One review says outright that if it had a pool it would be among the very top hotels in Udon · If you need to swim or work out, consider a hotel with fuller facilities in town · It does have a restaurant, bar, cafe and massage spa services.

faq.q: Is Hotel MOCO noisy — can you sleep well there?
faq.a: The plush beds and clean rooms get a lot of praise, but some reviews note fairly thin walls with street and live-music bar noise audible until late on certain nights · If you're a light sleeper, ask for an interior room away from the road and pack earplugs just in case · The hotel acknowledges this and has tried to improve it.

faq.q: Who is Hotel MOCO best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers who want a beautifully designed, clean room with a plush bed and great service, in a location walkable to UD Town and near the train station · It suits couples and travellers arriving by train or touring the city who value a comfortable room over a pool.

faq.q: What are the downsides to know before booking Hotel MOCO?
faq.a: The most common points are outside noise in some rooms and the lack of a pool and gym · Some also feel it's a touch pricey for the facilities, and a few restaurant staff speak limited English · These don't affect everyone, but choose your room and compare prices carefully before booking.
